description: Check heat stress for outdoor work: estimate WBGT from temperature and humidity (or use a measured WBGT), heat index, and the ACGIH work-rest regime for the work intensity and acclimatisation. Web version: https://irfanaslam.io/tools/heat-stress-calculator

acclimatised.description: Workers acclimatised to heat for 1-2 weeks. Default true.

in_direct_sun.description: Outdoors in direct sun (+3 C WBGT). Default true.

wbgt_c.description: A measured WBGT in C, instead of temperature and humidity.

name: heat_stress
title: Heat stress (WBGT) work-rest check
